description_en: Queries the information of the associated MSE microservice governance application
description_zh: 查询应用关联的MSE微服务治理应用信息
kebab_example: aliyun sae describe-application-mse-service --app-id f7730764-d88f-4b9a-8d8e-cd8efbfe0000 --enable-ahas true --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeApplicationMseService

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable traffic limiting and degradation. Set to true to check traffic limiting and degradation permissions when accessing related APIs; set to false otherwise
parameters.help_zh:
是否为限流降级功能。访问限流降级相关接口时填true，否则填false。
true 检查限流降级权限
false 不需要检查限流降级权限
parameters.name: enable_ahas

Code.description_en: The API status or POP error code. Valid values: 2xx: The request was successful. 3xx: The request was redirected. 4xx: The request was invalid. 5xx: A server error occurred
Code.description_zh: 接口状态或POP错误码。取值说明如下：2xx：成功。3xx：重定向。4xx：请求错误。5xx：服务器错误

Data.description_zh: MSE 微服务治理的应用信息

MseAppId.description_zh: MSE 微服务治理的应用ID

MseAppName.description_zh: MSE 微服务治理的应用名

MseAppNameSpace.description_zh: MSE 微服务治理的命名空间

Status.description_en:
The application status. Valid values:

EXPIRED

REBOOTING

WAITING

FAIL

NULL/SUCCESS
Status.description_zh:
MSE 微服务治应用状态
EXPIRED 已过期或者未开通相关功能
REBOOTING 应用重启中
WAITING 等待应用重启
FAIL 开通失败
NULL/SUCCESS 开通成功

ErrorCode.description_en:
The error code. Value description:

If the request succeeds, this field is not returned.

For more information, see the Error codes section of this topic
ErrorCode.description_zh:
错误码。取值说明如下：

请求成功：不返回ErrorCode字段。
请求失败：返回ErrorCode字段。具体信息，请参见本文的错误码列表

Message.description_en:
The additional information. Value description:

If the request was successful, success is returned.

If the request failed, an error code is returned
Message.description_zh:
附加信息。取值说明如下：

请求正常，返回success。
请求异常，返回具体异常错误码

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the application instance groups were obtained successfully. Valid values:

true

false
Success.description_zh:
获取应用实例分组是否成功。取值说明如下：

true：表示获取成功。
false：表示获取失败

TraceId.description_en: The ID of the trace, which is used to query the exact call information
TraceId.description_zh: 调用链ID，用于精确查询调用信息
